ns2:section.sectionText: This course will familiarize students with the topic of marketing communications and promotion management, and will teach students the steps for strategically planning a strategic brand communications campaign. The culmination of this course will be a campaign for a real-world client. 3 graduate hours. No professional credit. Non-Degree seeking students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of the department. To request enrollment, please email ms-sbc@illinois.edu.
